inputs.text: This is yet another instance of what occurs when we abandon personal responsibility and the traditional standards of integrity that have always supported stable communities and strong nations. South African actress Terry Pheto is once again mired in controversy over alleged financial misconduct involving R20.56 million from the National Lotteries Commission in an SIU probe. The information was presented during a briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026. Such issues arise when we exchange our time-honored values and national foundations for unaccountable modern institutions that undermine social order and cultural continuity.
